Date and time: Thursday, May 15, 2025, at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time Place: Live audio webcast at www.virtualshareholdermeeting.example/EVPK2025 Record date: March 21, 2025 Dear Fellow Stockholder: You are invited to attend the 2025 Annual Meeting of Stockholders of Eastvale Packaging Corporation. At the meeting, stockholders will be asked to: 1. Elect the nine director nominees named in this proxy statement to serve until the 2026 annual meeting; 2. Ratify the appointment of Kessler Whitfield LLP as our independent registered public accounting firm for fiscal 2025; 3. Approve, on an advisory basis, the compensation of our named executive officers; 4. Approve the Eastvale Packaging Corporation 2025 Omnibus Incentive Plan, which authorizes 2,400,000 shares; and 5. Consider a stockholder proposal requesting an independent board chair, if properly presented at the meeting. We will also transact any other business that properly comes before the meeting. Our Board of Directors recommends that you vote FOR Items 1 through 4 and AGAINST Item 5. Important notice regarding the availability of proxy materials for the Annual Meeting to be held on May 15, 2025: This proxy statement and our 2024 Annual Report on Form 10-K are available at www.eastvale-proxy.example. By order of the Board of Directors, Lorraine K. Whitaker Corporate Secretary April 3, 2025 **Why am I receiving these materials?** The Board of Directors is soliciting your proxy to vote at the annual meeting. You are receiving this proxy statement because you owned shares of common stock at the close of business on March 21, 2025, the record date. **How many shares are entitled to vote?** 38,209,774 shares of common stock were outstanding on the record date. Each share is entitled to one vote on each matter. **What is the quorum requirement?** A majority of the shares outstanding and entitled to vote, present in person or represented by proxy, constitutes a quorum. **How do I vote?** You may vote by Internet at www.proxyvote.example, by telephone at 1-800-555-0147, by returning a signed proxy card, or during the meeting. If you hold shares through a broker, you must give voting instructions to your broker; brokers may not vote on Items 1, 3, 4 or 5 without your instructions. **Can I change my vote?** Yes. You may revoke your proxy at any time before it is voted by submitting a later-dated proxy, by notifying the Corporate Secretary in writing or by voting at the meeting. **What vote is required?** Directors are elected by a majority of votes cast in uncontested elections. Items 2 through 5 require the affirmative vote of a majority of shares present and entitled to vote. Our stockholders approved last year's say-on-pay proposal with 94.2% of the votes cast. The Compensation Committee considered that result in structuring 2024 compensation. To be included in next year's proxy statement under Rule 14a-8, stockholder proposals must be received by our Corporate Secretary at 600 Eastvale Boulevard, Dayton, Ohio 45402 no later than December 4, 2025.
